title: FlowMemory Agent Memory Model
thesis: Everyone treated agent memory like retrieval. FlowMemory treats it like a memory model.
safeLaunchClaim: FlowMemory defines FMM-0, a receipt-bound memory consistency model for machine histories.

rules.name: Boundary Separation
rules.invariant: Swap execution, FlowPulse emission, and reader-derived receipt metadata are separate objects.

rules.name: Intentional Emission
rules.invariant: Memory emission requires explicit FlowMemory hookData with rootfieldId and commitment.

rules.name: Receipt Mapping
rules.invariant: Receipt-only fields cannot be dereferenced before reader mapping.

rules.name: Retirement
rules.invariant: Speculative artifacts cannot become live until a matching FlowPulse receipt retires them.

rules.name: Quiescence
rules.invariant: Active pre-boundary frames must quiesce, revalidate, fork, or abandon before joining post-boundary state.

rules.name: Serialization
rules.invariant: Agent histories must serialize around the FlowPulse receipt boundaries they claim to observe.

rules.name: Forbidden Outcomes
rules.invariant: A conforming runtime rejects impossible histories and accepts valid receipt-ordered histories.

rules.name: Public Release Evidence
rules.invariant: A public Base Sepolia release record attaches receipt-derived txHash/logIndex evidence from a real deployed hook.
